meta.title: Avoid network downloads in tests
meta.body_summary: Add local_gpt2_tokenizer fixture to avoid network downloads in GPT2-related tests; switch tests to use this fixture and use passthrough tokenizer for validation-set test.

perf_labels.notes: Small test fixture refactor to avoid network downloads; merged without formal review or benchmark evidence.

core_change_summary.description: Added local_gpt2_tokenizer fixture in tests/conftest.py to load GPT2 tokenizer from local files; replaced network-dependent tokenizer loading in test_sft.py, test_supervised.py, and test_text.py with this fixture; used passthrough tokenizer for validation-set test in test_text.py.
